Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Contract
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
We're looking for a Junior Software Test Engineer to join an engineering team developing software for advanced energy storage systems. You'll work alongside experienced engineers, contribute to software verification and validation activities, and develop your skills in embedded software testing.
 🔧 What will you do? 
Support the development and maintenance of functional test plans based on software requirements and customer specifications.
Configure and operate Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) test systems with guidance from experienced engineers.
Execute test cases, document results, and contribute to technical test reports.
Maintain traceability between software requirements and test cases and support test coverage reporting.
Assist in validating diagnostic services and fault-handling mechanisms using fault injection methods.
Support the analysis of real-time software behavior and timing constraints.
Review software requirements for clarity, correctness, and testability.
Use configuration management and issue-tracking tools to manage testing activities.
Support customer events, including vehicle integration and testing.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and contribute ideas to improve testing processes and infrastructure.
 🎯 What are we looking for? 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
Up to 2 years of relevant experience in embedded systems, software development, or software testing. Internships and university projects are welcome.
Knowledge of C programming and embedded software concepts .
Basic experience with software testing, debugging, or test documentation.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good communication skills, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn.
 ⭐ It would be a plus if you have: 
A Master's degree in Computer Engineering or Electrical Engineering.
Academic, internship, or project experience in embedded systems or automotive software.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and Jira.
Awareness of ASPICE or other structured software development processes.
Basic Python scripting skills.
Exposure to software verification, static analysis, unit testing, or debugging tools.
Basic knowledge of CAN/LIN communication and Vector tools such as CANoe, CANape, or CANalyzer.
Familiarity with requirements management tools such as IBM DOORS or Jama.
Experience with laboratory equipment, including multimeters, oscilloscopes, or logic analyzers.
Awareness of CI tools such as Azure Pipelines, GitLab CI, or Jenkins.
Exposure to Virtual ECU platforms such as Synopsys Silver or dSPACE VEOS.
 💡 Why consider this opportunity? 
Gain hands-on experience in embedded software testing and automotive technology.
Learn from experienced engineers in a collaborative technical environment.
Develop your skills in software verification, debugging, and test automation.
Contribute to the development of innovative energy storage technologies.
